title: 月亮变胖又变瘦
subtitle: 月亮每天都在换样子
character: wearing a navy blue pajama top, navy trousers and grey slippers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, scratchboard art: bright lines and shapes scratched out of a solid black ink surface, glowing white, pale yellow and soft blue lines on a deep black background

pages.zh:
晚上，我和爸爸在院子里乘凉。
天黑下来，星星一颗一颗亮起来。
爸爸指着天上说：
「你看，今天的月亮多圆。」
pages.scene: Night in a backyard: the little boy in pyjamas stands on the grass with his father, a tall grown adult man with short black hair in a grey shirt, beside him, both looking up at a big round full moon in a starry sky.

pages.zh:
今晚的月亮圆圆的，
亮亮的，挂在树梢上。
上面还有一块一块淡淡的影子，
像被谁轻轻擦过。
pages.scene: A big round full moon filling most of the picture, with faint darker patches on its surface, a few thin tree branches crossing in front of it, stars around.

pages.zh:
过了几天，我又去看月亮。
咦？它少了一小块。
右边圆圆的，
左边却像被咬掉了一口。
pages.scene: A gibbous moon in the night sky with one side round and the other side flattened and dark, a few stars around it.

pages.zh:
我把每天晚上看到的月亮，
都画在一个小本子上。
一页画一个。
画着画着，我发现——
它每天都不一样。
pages.scene: The little boy sits at a desk by a window at night with a small notebook open, drawing a moon shape with a pencil, several pages of different moon shapes pinned on the wall beside him.

pages.zh:
爸爸说，月亮自己不会发光。
它是一个又大又冷的石头球，
表面坑坑洼洼的，
没有一点自己的光。
pages.scene: A large grey rocky ball with craters floating alone on a black background, no light of its own, a few distant stars.

pages.zh:
我们看到的月光，
其实是太阳的光。
太阳照在月亮上，
月亮把光反射回来，
我们就看见它亮了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram on black: the sun at the left sending straight bright rays to a round moon on the right, and the lit side of the moon glowing.

pages.zh:
月亮一边自己转，
一边绕着地球转圈。
转一圈大约要一个月。
它离我们很远很远，
可是一直跟着地球走。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram on black: the earth in the middle and a moon on a circular dotted path around it, an arrow showing the direction of travel.

pages.zh:
太阳只能照亮月亮的一半。
被照到的那一半是亮的，
照不到的那一半是暗的。
我们看到多少亮的部分，
月亮就是什么样子。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram on black: a moon ball with its left half brightly lit by rays from the sun and its right half dark, seen from the side.

pages.zh:
月亮转到太阳这一边的时候，
亮的那一半背着我们，
我们就几乎看不见它。
这时候的月亮，
叫做新月。
pages.scene: A night sky that is almost empty: only a very faint dark circle where the moon is, surrounded by stars, one thin outline showing where the moon hides.

pages.zh:
又过两三天，
天边出现一条细细的月牙，
弯弯的，像一只小船。
它出现在太阳落下的方向。
pages.scene: A thin crescent moon low in the dark sky just above the horizon line, with the last glow of sunset at the horizon and a few stars above.

pages.zh:
月牙一天比一天胖。
先是细细的一条，
然后变成半个圆——
这是上弦月，
晚上早早就能看见。
pages.scene: A first quarter moon, exactly half lit on the right side and half dark, high in a starry sky.

pages.zh:
再过几天，
月亮几乎全亮了，
只剩一点点缺口。
最后终于变成一个大圆盘：
满月。
pages.scene: Two moons drawn side by side on black: a nearly full moon with a small dark sliver on one side, and next to it a completely round full moon.

pages.zh:
满月之后，
月亮又开始一点点变瘦。
先缺一小块，
再变成半个圆，
最后又剩下一条细细的月牙。
pages.scene: Three moon shapes in a row on black: a nearly full moon, a half moon, and a thin crescent, showing the shape getting smaller from left to right.

pages.zh:
从新月到满月，
再从满月回到新月，
大约要二十九天半。
月亮的这些样子，
有一个名字，叫做「月相」。
pages.scene: A circular chart on black: eight moon shapes arranged in a ring, going from a dark new moon through crescent, half, gibbous, full and back again.

pages.zh:
所以，看看月亮，
就能猜出今天是这个月的哪几天。
以前的人出海、种地，
都靠月亮数日子。
pages.scene: An old paper calendar page on a dark table lit by moonlight, with small moon shapes drawn in the corner of some of the day squares.

pages.zh:
中秋节那天，月亮最圆。
我们一家坐在院子里吃月饼。
妈妈说：
「今天的月亮，和你出生那天一样圆。」
pages.scene: Night in the backyard: the little boy sits at a small table with his mother, a grown adult woman with short black hair in a red sweater, and his father, a tall grown adult man with short black hair in a grey shirt,, a plate of round mooncakes on the table, a big full moon above them, warm lantern light.

pages.zh:
爸爸拿出一个小望远镜。
我凑上去一看——
月亮上真的有好多坑！
有大的，有小的，
一个挨着一个。
pages.scene: The little boy looks through a small telescope on a tripod in the backyard at night, one eye closed, his mouth open in surprise, the moon glowing above.

pages.zh:
该睡觉了。
我躺在床上，
月光从窗户照进来，
照在我的被子上。
明天的月亮，又会变一点点。
pages.scene: The little boy lies in bed under a blanket at night, moonlight coming through the window and falling across his blanket, a crescent moon visible outside the glass.
